authorization.decision: delegated recommendation instruction: reconcile a changed recommendation set, validate the 2ZD-4 values, and prepare a protocol amendment
authorization.instrument: the owner's written Stage 2ZH instruction of 2026-11-14
authorization.scope: docs/research/stage2zh/ only; drafts and reconciliation only; no data access; no amendment adoption; no owner signature, date, or affirmation

deliverables.role: Reconciliation of the changed recommendation set against the authoritative sources: C-N validity under the packet and D-11, R-b consistency with the section 10.4 counter-route recorded, the S-1 risk and frequency arithmetic, and the seven selections with their ratification routes

The minimum protocol section 8.2 amendment that makes R-b operative: definitions of reserved contact, the custodian role, delivery limits, the access log, non-derogation, the rejected hash-only variant, and finding Y-1 on the Stage 2ZC boundary probes

Field-by-field validation of the seven Stage 2ZD-4 values against four support tiers, the leakage and artificial-independence tests, the 90-day embargo derivation, the custody procedure with its trust limit, and the unresolved exit-policy dependency
The seven proposed selections in the Stage 2ZD packet's field format, each labelled unratified, with the amendment and custodian dependencies disclosed and no owner date, statement, or signature

What the stage was authorized to do, what it did, what the two instruments would resolve, what remains unauthorized, the five requirements a Gate 2 opening would still need, and the stage's own zero-access record

findings.summary: Under R-b any byte contact is a read, so the four disclosed Stage 2ZC boundary open_time inspections count as reserved contact; the amendment is prospective and cannot legitimise them retroactively
findings.treatment: recorded as a pre-amendment deviation; grandfathering left to the owner

findings.summary: Protocol section 10.4 permits a pre-registered interpretation to resolve an ambiguity, so R-b is the stricter route rather than the only route
findings.treatment: recorded; R-b still preferred for scope, subject matter, and versioning reasons

findings.summary: 10,000 resamples and seed 20240101 appear in one prior recommendation only, not in the protocol, the register, the 2J plan, or the Stage 6 protocol
findings.treatment: marked precedent-thin; the registration must disclose them as a comparability choice

findings.summary: Candidate D's specification contains no exit or holding rule, so episode adequacy and embargo sufficiency are conditional on the registered holding policy
findings.treatment: left open; it is the only item that blocks a Gate 2 registration

hashing_procedure: SHA256 over the UTF-8 canonical JSON encoding (json.dumps, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) of this object with the self_hash field removed. The file is written with indent=2, sort_keys=True and a trailing newline.
nature: Decision reconciliation, methodology validation, and governance draft preparation only. No reserved byte read, streamed, decoded, or hashed; no dataset file streamed; no census, backtest, simulation, parameter fit, strategy experiment, cost or liquidity measurement, quote sampling, venue contact, order, or real-capital sizing. No predecessor document modified; no protocol or addendum text changed; no gate moved.
no_performance_claim: No expected return, profitability, achievable income, execution-feasibility, or real-capital claim is made. Both candidates remain at FEASIBILITY FAIL - INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES; no hypothesis is registered; 26 bp is an unmeasured assumption.
open_items: adoption of the amendment draft under protocol section 10.2, with a dated owner statement naming its hash
the custodian appointment, even where the owner is the custodian
a registered exit and holding policy
the planning DE and p_exec brackets at registration under E-2
the hypothesis C-N withholds, without which Gate 2 cannot be registered

predecessor_manifest_verification.note: the Stage 2ZG manifest's canonical self-hash was recomputed with the declared procedure, and each referenced deliverable path-and-sha256 pair was re-hashed from current bytes

proposed_selections.2ZD-1: R-b (requires the amendment draft to be adopted)
proposed_selections.2ZD-2: C-N (valid under the packet; D-11 forbids more than one primary, not zero)

2ZD-4.custodian: the human owner under the logged custody procedure
2ZD-4.opening: after the Gate 2 freeze and the Gate 4 audit, at Gate 5 only, once, logged
